WITH budget_with_event AS (
  SELECT 
    b.budget_id,
    b.link_to_event,
    e.status,
    b.remaining,
    b.spent,
    b.amount
  FROM budget b
  INNER JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
),
event_level_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    link_to_event,
    status,
    AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG(CAST(spent - amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(amount, 0)) as avg_overspend_rate
  FROM budget_with_event
  GROUP BY link_to_event, status
),
global_mean_remaining AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_remaining) as mean_remaining
  FROM event_level_stats
),
status_level_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    status,
    AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining_by_status,
    AVG(avg_overspend_rate) as avg_overspend_rate_by_status
  FROM event_level_stats
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 
  s.status,
  s.avg_remaining_by_status,
  s.avg_overspend_rate_by_status,
  s.avg_remaining_by_status / NULLIF(g.mean_remaining, 0) as ratio
FROM status_level_stats s
CROSS JOIN global_mean_remaining g
